req.title: Fetching completed tasks
req.statement: The system shall optionally filter tasks by completed status when a filter query parameter is supplied.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should filter tasks by their completion status when a query parameter is provided. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct filtering, a negative test to handle invalid input, and a boundary test to ensure correct behavior at the edge of the dataset.

tests.name: test_fetch_completed_tasks_positive
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with tasks, some completed and some not.
expected: Response contains only tasks with completed status true
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/tasks/?completed=true')
assert response.status_code == 200
completed_tasks = response.json()
assert all(task['completed'] is True for task in completed_tasks)
assert len(completed_tasks) == 6  # Based on pre-loaded data

tests.name: test_fetch_completed_tasks_negative
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/tasks/?completed=invalid')
assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_fetch_completed_tasks_boundary
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/tasks/?completed=true&limit=6')
assert response.status_code == 200
completed_tasks = response.json()
assert len(completed_tasks) == 6  # Boundary case for limit
